rule.addressability: pre-ranking veto not-addressable:non-ascii-symbol for non-ASCII symbols (NEWCORE cannot address them); each week lists them in not_addressable with the veto they would otherwise have had, their exact qv30d and their would-be rank / top-40 flag in their book
rule.books: ranked separately per asset-class book; unclassified symbols join no book
rule.complete_window: all 30 daily bars present, else veto data-gap (never zero volume); a listed contract with no bar in the window and no delist observation is vetoed data-gap:window-absent with a 30-day gap entry (never dropped silently)
rule.delist_veto: timestamped observations only; archive end is hindsight, audit only
rule.renames: refused (fail closed) until time-scoped identity + price-continuity evidence exists
rule.score: exact decimal sum of quote_volume of 1d bars with open in [instant-30d, instant-1d] (available_ms <= instant)
rule.warmup_test: per strategy, applied by the R3 harness (independent of the listing-age test)
